# Mosaic ERP

Mosaic ERP is an MIT-licensed, interview-native operational ERP for evidence-backed core retailer work. It turns plain-language owner answers into real controls and supports buying, receiving, selling, returns/refunds, stock, cash, supplier bills/payments, reconciliation, period close and core accounting reports. Built-in deterministic chat is the default, and users can optionally connect their own AI provider. Setup and configuration are guided in chat; provider secrets use a masked secure step and never enter chat, logs, exports, or audit detail. The fine-tuned local assistant is being tested and is not available in v1.2.0.

Current verified source facts for the v1.2.0 candidate: guided setup; built-in deterministic chat by default; optional chat-guided bring-your-own AI-provider setup with masked secret handling; core retailer transactions; core accounting; fine-grained operational access; PostgreSQL restricted-runtime-role tenant isolation; concurrency and failure acceptance; strict Helm/deployment checks; configuration-aware real Google/Microsoft OIDC routes with provider-published assets. Fresh release archives, checksums, container digests, signatures, SBOM/provenance and vulnerability-scan results are pending the final tag workflow and must not be inferred from v1.1.0.

Boundaries: statutory invoices, tax filing, e-invoicing and jurisdiction certification are excluded unless a separate local adapter/version is reviewed by the business owner or a named professional. Advanced retail, manufacturing, payroll and broad enterprise-suite modules are excluded. Operators own DNS/TLS, provider registration and secrets, managed PostgreSQL HA/PITR, restore drills, cluster failover/capacity evidence, monitoring and independent penetration testing before real hosted financial-data use. SQLite is for local evaluation or simple single-process use; concurrent production replicas require external PostgreSQL.
